meta.title: C3A — Migration Through Artificial Night
meta.brightness_definition: Red-channel display intensity sampled from the existing 2024 VIIRS globe tile at zoom 9, divided by 255. It is a monotonic visual proxy, not physical radiance.
meta.high_brightness_threshold_method: 90th percentile of non-zero relative display brightness across all retained migration points; zero/dark points remain in each proportion denominator.
meta.gps_argos_rule: Robin Argos points within 6 hours of a GPS point for the same individual are excluded in favour of GPS.
meta.interpretation: Shows where tracked birds passed through darker and brighter 2024 nighttime environments. It does not test whether artificial light caused route choice or movement change.
